title.headline:
85 projects.
Every lease in one Vault.

end.line: Quillon for Aldermoor Energy’s legal team

vo: Aldermoor Energy's legal team supports eighty-five wind and solar projects. Here is that work in Quillon.
Move the leases and grid agreements from shared drives into Vault. Each one is read at once, and consent terms come back flagged.
When a developer emails a consent question, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the lease clause.
Ask one question across a whole project, and Quillon reads every lease and grid agreement before it answers.
Freya will walk your team through it on Monday the sixteenth.
